mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1000 TR_NUM AS [key], REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),TR_SENDDATE, 120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS request_date, TR_ID AS department_code, TR_PHONE AS phone, TR_CALLBACK AS callback_number, TR_MSG AS message, TR_MSGTYPE AS message_type, TR_KISAORIGCODE AS kisa_origin_code, TR_REALID AS real_id FROM ${tableName} WHERE TR_SENDSTAT = '0' AND TR_SENDDATE < GETDATE() ORDER BY TR_SENDDATE
